title: The 2 Best Mechanical Keyboards 2026
metaDescription: Our 2 picks for mechanical keyboards 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at mechanical keyboards 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Corsair K70 RGB PRO
products.blurb: Key specs: 8,000 Hz hyper-polling, PBT double-shot keycaps.
strengths: Cherry MX Speed switches are extremely fast and consistent
limitations: Full-size footprint takes up desk space

products.name: HyperX Alloy Origins Core
products.blurb: Key specs: HyperX linear Red switches, Per-key RGB.
strengths: Tenkeyless layout frees space for mouse movement
Solid aluminum body for its price
HyperX linear or tactile switch options
limitations: Stock ABS keycaps can develop shine over time
